description: This file defines the CustomWeightBasedShippingQuote class, which implements the ShippingQuoteModule interface to generate shipping options based on package weight and region-specific configurations. It includes methods for retrieving module configuration, validating configuration, and calculating shipping quotes based on weight thresholds and region criteria.

classes.name: CustomWeightBasedShippingQuote
classes.description: Implementation of ShippingQuoteModule that calculates shipping cost based on weight thresholds and regional configuration.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the shipping module configuration; currently not used, with a comment indicating complex validation occurs elsewhere.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the custom shipping configuration for a merchant store from the database.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Calculates and returns a list of shipping options based on package weights, regions, and configured weight-to-price mappings.
